name: Derive the APT exact-factor pricing relation E[Rᵢ]−r = Σₖ βᵢₖ λₖ from no-arbitrage
description: No-arbitrage in an exact multi-factor model forces asset intercepts to be affine in the factor loadings.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Portfolio.ArbitragePricingTheory

open MathFin

/-- No-arbitrage in an exact multi-factor model forces asset intercepts to be affine in the factor loadings. -/
theorem mf_portfolio_apt_exact_factor_pricing {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (β : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (h_no_arb : ∀ w : ι → ℝ,
      portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 →
      (∀ k ∈ t, portfolioReturn s w (fun i ↦ β i k) = 0) →
      portfolioReturn s w a = 0) :
    ∃ (lam0 : ℝ) (lam : κ → ℝ), ∀ i ∈ s, a i = lam0 + ∑ k ∈ t, β i k * lam k :=
  MathFin.apt_exact_factor_pricing s t a β h_no_arb
